title: Shopah
description: Making player shops easy using signs!
body:
# Shopah

Lightweight item-based trading shops for Minecraft. No economy plugin needed — players trade items directly.

## Features
- Simple setup — Sign on chest/barrel, write [Trade], right-click to configure
- Any item as currency — Emeralds, diamonds, custom items, whatever
- Live signs — Displays item, price, and stock status
- Protected — Griefing, explosions, and hopper theft prevention
- Zero dependencies — No Vault, no economy plugin

## How to Use
1. Place a wall sign on a chest or barrel
2. Write [Trade] on line 1
3. Right-click sign with item and amount you're selling per trade
4. Right-click again with the amount of currency item you're asking for per trade
5. Done — customers right-click to buy

## Commands

/shopah info — View shop details
/shopah set <amount> [items | stacks]

## Permissions

**Permission	Default**
shopah.setup	OP
shopah.break	OP
shopah.open	    OP
shopah.admin	OP
